create_dadapt_adamw_optimizer: create a learning-rate-free AdamW optimizer using D-Adaptation with configurable betas, eps, and weight_decay
build_dadapt_adamw_state: build the DAdaptAdamWState NamedTuple containing exp_avg, exp_avg_sq, grad_sum, estim_lr, numerator_weighted, and count
test_dadapt_adamw_with_schedule: test dadapt_adamw with a linear learning rate schedule that treats 1.0 as the base value and includes warmup
refactor_dadapt_adamw_weight_decay: refactor dadapt_adamw to apply AdamW-style weight decay with configurable decay rate
review_dadapt_adamw_update_fn: review the dadapt_adamw update function that adapts the learning rate by estimating distance to solution
